name: Busy parent planning a class party
description: A parent who needs three facts quickly: opening hours, the price of a dozen cupcakes and how far ahead to order.
goals: Learn the price of a dozen cupcakes
Learn how much lead time the bakery needs for a cupcake order
constraints: Asks all three questions, in one or two messages
Will ask again once if the lead time answer is vague
communication: Polite but rushed. Writes in quick bursts, sometimes several questions at once.
initial_message: Hi! What are Maple Street Bakery's hours, how much is a dozen cupcakes, and how far ahead do I need to order them?
